name: Jin Ting Wan
address: Marina Bay Sands Hotel, Tower 1, Level 55, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
lunchNoteZh: 午餐供應相同套餐，每日

menus.name: tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, daily; the whole table takes it; four-wine pairing S$118, or a three-tea pairing S$118

bookingOpens: Online on the Marina Bay Sands website for up to six guests, or by phone.
groups: For more than six guests, send a request through the online booking page and the restaurant confirms. There are private dining rooms and a chef's table.
dressCode: Smart casual. Men wear collared shirts or smart T-shirts with closed-toe shoes; tailored shorts are allowed at lunch only. No slippers, flip-flops, singlets, swimwear, gym wear or hotel robes; guests not dressed to the code may be turned away.
duration: About an hour and a half for lunch and two hours for dinner.
